ledger.claim: The driver never entered the arrival geofence. Across all 65 fixes in the driver's trace his closest approach to the pickup pin was 647.5 m, and the derived arrival block records 0 qualifying in-radius fixes with a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds, against a STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m set by the fee schedule and applied to this STANDARD-zone pickup. POL-NS-02 requires at least 3 consecutive fixes at 25 m accuracy or better inside that radius; there are none anywhere in the trip. POL-NS-01 limb (b) therefore fails and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and the driver side must carry all four limbs, so breaking any one of them defeats the fee. Limb (b) fails on the trace numbers above, and limb (c) fails independently: the measured in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the free waiting period of 180 seconds carried in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, a shortfall of 180 seconds. The driver's cancellation at 22:52:58, some 5 minutes after his own arrival tap, was therefore a cancellation with no qualifying dwell behind it at all - a fact that reads the same for the rider whether the 5 minutes are counted from the tap or from the trace.

Independently of any arrival question, POL-NS-06 refunds the fee where the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the free waiting period in force. The measured dwell here is 0 seconds against the 180 seconds required for this STANDARD zone, and the shortfall is stated in the derived block as 180 seconds. POL-NS-06(ii) is explicit that a shortfall is never excused on its own; an advisory can only permit separate in-geofence intervals to be summed, and there are no intervals to sum. The SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable.

The 'I'm Here' tap at 22:47:56 is a FALSE arrival marker. POL-NS-05 treats the marker as false where the trace places the driver more than 300 m from the pin at that timestamp, and the minimum distance across the whole trace is 647.5 m - more than double the threshold - so the driver was no closer than 647.5 m at the moment he tapped, the best the trace allows him. The waiting clock never lawfully started, and because there is no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere in the trip, POL-NS-05(ii) applies: the fee is refunded in full, no compensation is payable, and the false-arrival event is recorded against the driver. The same conclusion follows for the motion limb as well: the recorded speeds run from 26.7 km/h up to 62.3 km/h, well above the 15 km/h test, and 0.0 km/h appears only for a stationary interval that the distance test already shows was nowhere near the pin.

POL-NS-03 does not rescue this fee. That clause requires the driver to have been stationary for the required dwell outside the arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pickup pin, and the distance test is the whole clause; the driver's closest approach on the trace is 647.5 m, beyond the 400 m ceiling, so this is not a wrong-face-of-the-same-venue case - on POL-NS-01's own words, fixes more than 400 m from the pin mean the driver never arrived and POL-NS-02 governs. Nor is there any corroboration in the other direction: no venue_id is recorded for the driver's position, so under POL-NS-03 nothing establishes that the two positions were the same venue, block or entrance.

The driver cannot fall back on accumulated dwell, and the missing advisory is why. EV-ADVIS-03203-01 is MISSING - no traffic advisory covers Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd in this window (MISSING_ARTIFACT, severity BLOCKING, weight_multiplier 0.0). POL-NS-06(i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a traffic_advisory that is present and populated covers the pickup road with an admissible type, and the clause says in terms that a MISSING advisory makes limb (i) unavailable and that no advisory ever reduces the required minimum. I cite that artifact only for its absence, which is itself a legitimate ground under POL-GEN-02; it carries no fact and exonerates no one.

There is no platform-confirmed arrival here to lean on. The record the driver relies on is a driver-pressed marker: trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is BUTTON and the event log shows only 'Driver tapped "I'm Here"'. POL-NS-12's shortcut, which treats platform telemetry as a carrier independent of a sparse export, applies only where arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO and the platform records its own geofence test with matching wait-timer events; it expressly excludes a BUTTON marker. The arrival must therefore be tested against the trace under POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05, where it fails on the 647.5 m figure.

The rider's own track corroborates her account that she stood at the pickup watching the map. All 53 rider fixes lie within 15.8 m of the pin (minimum 8.6 m, mean 12.4 m), stationary throughout at a single recorded speed of 0.0 km/h, so rider_qualifying_fix_count is 53 of 53 against the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius - she was at the pin while the driver's nearest fix was 647.5 m away, and the driver's own chat line 'im here already' at 22:49:06 was sent to a rider the trace places there. That satisfies POL-NS-04 limb (c). I do not rest the case on POL-NS-04, however: the driver replied 30 seconds after her message, so limb (b)'s 120 second silence condition is not met and that clause cannot be the route to relief. The refund stands on the driver's own evidence under POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06.

No driver compensation is payable, so the rider's refund is not offset by any payment to the driver. POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. POL-NS-01 fails at limbs (b) and (c) on this record, and POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 each independently displace the fee, so the compensation condition is never reached and the anti-farming check on the driver's profile is never reached either.

This case is decidable now and should not be sent to human review, because escalation holds the fee rather than returning it. None of POL-NS-09's triggers fires: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 against limb (d)'s threshold of 3; rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so limb (c)'s requirement of 2 or more no-show disputes between the same pair is not met; every artifact in the bundle except the missing advisory carries weight 1.0 and is COMPLETE, so limb (e) does not apply; and the only apparent conflict - the driver's arrival tap against a trace that places him 647.5 m away - is resolved by POL-NS-05 as a false marker rather than left open, so limb (b) does not apply. POL-GEN-03 defines ESCALATE as holding the disputed amount; the rider's money should be returned.

The money follows the findings. The fare ledger shows total_charged SGD 4.50, all of it the cancellation-fee line, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the charge reconciles to the net figure the fee schedule produces for this trip, so there is no integrity defect on the amount - the rider's whole contested sum is still with the platform. Under POL-GEN-03 the correct value is therefore FULL_REFUND of SGD 4.50 to the filing rider, not PARTIAL_REFUND, because no part of this charge is supportable on the trace, and not NO_ACTION, which would leave the charge standing.

Two of POL-NS-01's four limbs are carried by the platform's own telemetry. Limb (a) is met: the trip record contains a driver_arrived event at 2026-09-19T22:47:56+08:00. Limb (d) is met: the trip was terminated by the driver at 22:52:58 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises, and no boarding event is recorded. The driver did not mis-select his reason code, so the driver-education referral that POL-NS-01 reserves for a mis-selected code is not in play.

The rider's separate exoneration route under POL-NS-04 does not open on this record. The rider's locating message ('where are you? i dont see any car') was sent at 22:48:36 and the driver posted a reply ('im here already') at 22:49:06 - 30 seconds later, well inside the 120-second window POL-NS-04(b) allows - and the clause requires only that the driver answer within that window; it does not require the answer to be accurate or helpful. Limb (b) therefore fails, POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, and the dispute falls to be decided under POL-NS-01 on the arrival and dwell evidence rather than on coordination fault.

The amount charged is not impeachable on accounting grounds. The fare_breakdown cancellation-fee line of 4.50 SGD reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50 SGD for this trip under fee_schedule.resolution_rule, so no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect exists and nothing in the fare record supports disturbing the figure. Any outcome against the fee must come from the arrival and dwell tests of POL-NS-01, not from the arithmetic of the charge.

Nor does anything on the profiles withhold compensation or escalate this case. POL-NS-07's anti-farming check requires no_show_terminations_30d of 4 or more AND a ratio to completed_trips_30d above 0.08; the record shows 1 termination against 66 completed trips in 30 days, about 0.015, so the check does not trip. POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged either, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d being 0, and POL-NS-09(c) is not engaged because both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0. There is no abuse pattern on either side of this trip.

Under POL-GEN-01 the driver's rating (4.78), acceptance rate (0.928), account age (992 days) and lifetime trip count (3467) are CONTEXT ONLY: they may not, alone or in combination, establish any fact about this trip or carry an adverse finding against him. The only profile fields citable against the driver are no_show_terminations_30d and completed_trips_30d, and only for the POL-NS-07 anti-farming test, which does not trip.

ledger.claim: The driver does not contest the arrival and dwell limbs, and does not stretch the record to do so. His own trace places his closest approach to the pickup pin at 647.5 m across 65 fixes (mean 1732.1 m), with zero qualifying in-radius fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0 seconds. Limb (b) and limb (c) of POL-NS-01 therefore fail on a clean, unimpaired trace (100.0% coverage, 10 s cadence, max gap 0.0 s), the stationary fixes lie beyond the 400 m ceiling that would bring POL-NS-03 into play so that POL-NS-02 governs, and the false-arrival consequence of POL-NS-05(ii) follows. The driver's case rests on the four points above and on nothing else.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 is refunded in full to the rider. The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-03203, weight 1.0) shows his closest approach to the pickup pin at Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd was 647.5 m, with 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds, against the STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m. The trip record (EV-TRIP-03203, weight 1.0) contains a driver-pressed 'I'm Here' event at 22:47:56, but under POL-NS-02 that is not an admissible arrival, and under POL-NS-05 it is a false arrival marker because the trace places the driver more than 300 m from the pin. POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) therefore fail, and POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05(ii) require the cancellation fee to be refunded in full and no driver compensation to be paid. POL-NS-07 cannot pay the driver because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full and POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 independently displace the fee. The charged amount was SGD 4.50 (EV-FARE-03203), matching platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50, so no fare-integrity defect changes the figure. The rider's POL-NS-04 route does not decide the case: although the rider sent a locating message at 22:48:36, the driver replied at 22:49:06, within the 120-second window, so POL-NS-04(b) fails and that clause cannot exonerate her. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-03203-01, weight 0.0) carries no fact; its absence only confirms POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable and does not lower the confidence cap. All artifacts carrying the deciding facts have weight 1.0, so confidence is set at 0.95. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger applies: the profiles show no abuse pattern, there is no unresolved direct contradiction left by POL-NS-05, and the evidence is not impaired. The driver's own concession that his trace shows no arrival is accepted. The rider's arithmetic and no-escalation points are accepted. The only clause-mandated referral is the false-arrival record under POL-NS-05(ii).

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
referrals: POL-NS-05(ii): record a false-arrival event against driver DRV-10203 on trip TRP-03203, because the driver-pressed arrival marker at 2026-09-19T22:47:56+08:00 was more than 300 m from the pickup pin and the GPS trace contains no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere in the trip.
